notes.title: 🤝 Time to Unite 🤝 The Swarm Together Update is Now Available
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow ants,

The time to unite has finally come!

The Swarm Together Update is Now Available in Empire of the Ants

[previewyoutube=oFgZ1NOvIgI;full][/previewyoutube]
This free content update brings a lot of new things to the game:

🎮 New Game Modes
Co-Op Mode
Available in Mutiplayer hub
Play with a friend against 2 AIs
Each player starts with 2 nests, and cooperation will be key to defeat the enemy team
Horde Mode
Available for 1 player in Skirmish hub and 2 players in Multiplayer hub
Defend your nests against unending waves of enemies
Waves grow stronger and stronger
Waves are always composed differently
Story Challenge Mode
Available in Skirmish hub
Replay 6 missions from the main campaign in a more challenging format
Some actions, from the attacks to the movements, will cost points
Some other, such as defeating an enemy nest, will grant you additional points
Finish the mission with the highest score possible
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43519985/f401c1b97dfcea0ff8f1d9fef3801b1259ba9ae8.png

🐜 New In-Game Content
New Map: The Riverside
Designed specifically for large scale battles, this strip of land is the ideal place for 2 v 2 combats
New Support Unit: The Paussus
A stealthy unit which cannot be detected by units without a certain range, nor enemy nests
Steals the economic and information upgrades of enemy nests
Weak during fights, using the Paussus will require some strategy to be used at its full potential
New Power: Pheromone Storm
Create a huge smoke-filled area where information is not displayed
Upgrading it will extend its duration
Some upgrades and power can counter its effect
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43519985/eaa44e8a2266fd5f5495eaaacc517b79bb65909c.png

🛠️ Misc. Changes
Loadout Setup
Dedicated loadouts for the Skirmish and Multiplayer hubs
Set up to 5 loadouts which include units and powers
When the map is set, choose which loadout you want to play with
New AI Difficulties
”Imba”, “Unfair” and “Darwin”
Balancing
Information upgrades now cost less resources to build
Aphids now grant a movement boost while moving
Snails move 30% faster
Dor Beetles now receive 5-10% less damage across the board
Hornets now receive 10-15% more damage from gunners
Flying units, such as the Rhino Beetle, can now be sent directly to a nest
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43519985/ce0611d01efc3a347c713b92a0c1d9d2579b67ab.jpg

We hope you’ll have as much fun playing with these new additions as we enjoyed crafting them!

For the glory of the colony 🌿🐜

notes.title: ☀️ Upcoming Swarm Together Update 5/5 - New Unit & Power 🌪️
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow ants,

The Swarm Together update will bring new options to fight in all the different modes, except for the Story Mode. These options are: a new support unit and a new power. (Yes, we know support units might not be your favourite to play with, but this one brings something very unique to the table)

🐜 Introducing the Paussus
The Paussus is a stealthy unit. You will only be able to detect it if one of your units is close to it. Your nest will NOT detect it. So, unless you see the Paussus unit coming for your nest, you will get no other warning that something is happening. But what does this Paussus unit do? Why should you be worried?

Because it is good at pretending to be a friendly ant, it takes that opportunity to steal a nest’s eggs and food. To be more precise, it copies and sends over some of your Nest upgrades benefits while also disabling some functions of the nest it is “sitting” on.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43519985/8fb050353da78b7ccddd34a0c7f089669b1b7696.jpg
In terms of gameplay, how does that affect your upgrades in the infested nest?
The economy upgrades are fully copied over to the enemy. (Yes, even the chemical laboratory and library) This nest will stop giving you any income
The information upgrades are fully copied over, but you don’t lose anything
The defense upgrades are unaffected
The legion upgrades are unaffected, but the unit will not regenerate if it is dead
The power upgrades are unaffected
This is a powerful effect! But, the downside is that the Paussus is not a combat unit, and it is the most expensive support unit.

🌪️ Unleash the Pheromone Storm
To help the Paussus reach the enemy base undetected, a new power comes into play: the Pheromone Storm.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43519985/40cb4d2f3a15063bbe4c7a56fe1c3e5f8eca7f1d.gif

This power creates a huge smoke-filled area where information is not displayed. To see anything in it you will need to be close to it. This disables visual and UI elements from that zone, preventing you from knowing what is happening inside. Very powerful for sneak attacks and playing mind games with your opponent the next time. Careful though: some information upgrades and powers have been tweaked to counter the Pheromone Storm’s effect…

notes.title: ☀️ Upcoming Swarm Together Update 4/5 - Challenge Mode ⏲️
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow ants,

Whether you're a hardcore gamer or someone who just doesn’t want to go into PvP but would like a bigger challenge, we have designed the new Challenge Mode for you!

This mode will enable you to perfect your game style against a slightly enhanced AI player. The goal here is not to beat the AI player: this is a given. The goal is to defeat it and get the highest score possible.

You will be able to replay 6 specific story missions:
Cut the Head
Before the Storm
Pinecone Battle
Battle of the Arch
Close Quarters
Killing to Unite
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43519985/a3f353c471a50ffb1c96f7cd2cb30bc43dc4d164.jpg
The goal is to be fast, to upgrade to a higher tier at the perfect moment, and to defeat your opponent with minimal losses and maximum kills. The more time passes, the more points you lose. This resets when upgrading to a higher tier, making upgrading an essential skill in this specific mode to reduce the amount of points lost, and gathering resources will also bring you points. But don’t take too long, this last source of points income is not incremental. And you can only upgrade twice…

These challenges are designed to make you play the game and think about your strategies differently. They are not meant to train you for PvP, but to enjoy a new and fun way to play strategy missions.
[hr][/hr]
As you may have noticed in the title, we have one piece of news left to share with you tomorrow before the Swarm Together update releases. Although, you’re probably wondering when it is coming out… We’ll let you in on something: it’s sooner than you might think 👀

notes.title: ☀️ Upcoming Summer Update 3/5 - QoL & Balancing ⚖️
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow ants,

Let’s start this one off with the balancing and explaining what we did to make the Information Upgrades more fun and useful. Currently, Information Upgrades are too expensive and don’t perform as well as we have intended them to.

This is why we have severely reduced the price for most of them and the space they take up (a patch note will be coming with the Summer Update detailing these exact changes). Coupled with the new unit and new power, we think you will soon see added value to this forgotten upgrade branch.

But these are not the only balancing changes; we changed some of the super predators, but more importantly, the support units. Snails will move 30% faster, while Aphids will give a speed boost to units around them when they are moving (instead of healing for units that are unhurt).

We have also added some Quality of Life improvements. The first one is the option to make and save different loadouts.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43519985/ce0611d01efc3a347c713b92a0c1d9d2579b67ab.jpg
This is coupled with the main course: the possibility to choose your saved loadout right before launching a PvP match. This means that you’ll see which map you will be playing on and choose your loadout based on that information. This works for all the non-Story modes. (So in the Skirmish and Multiplayer modes)

Also, we have changed the fact that flying units could not be sent to an enemy nest. Rhino beetles will now be easier to use.

The Summer Update is slowly approaching, but not there yet. We still have a couple more things to tell you about before it lands in your garden!

⚔️ Don’t forget to tune at 4pm CEST/10am EST/7am PDT to watch an Exhibition Match between the Dev & Community Representatives, featuring the new Summer Update content ☀️

notes.title: ☀️ Upcoming Summer Update 2/5 - Co-Op, New Map & New AI Difficulty 🤝
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow ants,

Co-op is coming! Have you always wanted to play with a friend instead of against that friend? This will be possible with the Summer update, coming in a not-so-distant future! (Our ants are still working on it, ensuring that all the chambers are correctly protected against unwanted bugs)

In the co-op mode, you will either play with a friend against hordes of enemies (see our previous announcement for more details) or against 2 other AI enemies in a 2 vs 2 scenario. In both modes, you will be able to discover a whole new map we designed specifically for such large battles.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43519985/d4def475413b0eee1af46c1143890e0290afed93.jpg

In 2 vs 2 AI, you will also have the opportunity to test your strategies against stronger AI players, if you decide to face them. (These new AI difficulties are also available in single-player skirmishes)

The new map brings you to the riverbed that is separating Bel-o-kan territories from the new Ta-yu-kan; it has seen a lot of combat during the events unfolding during the fall season. Experience once more some of the fiercest fights ever fought during those events, pitting sisters against sisters. We hope you’ll enjoy exploring and fighting on this new map as much as we did crafting it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43519985/c7975fd6b8a51f0753dbf48bc5ecb67055d370aa.jpg

We still have a lot more to share before the update is upon us!

notes.title: ☀️ Upcoming Summer Update 1/5 - Horde Mode ⚔️
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow ants,

Time sure flies, and summer is already upon us… The colony is now bustling with activity in anticipation of the upcoming Summer Update! We have planned quite a few additions to improve your experience with Empire of the Ants, but today we will focus on one in particular:

Stand Your Ground in Horde Mode
Our new Horde Mode will let you play solo or co-op against unending waves of enemies. Waves grow stronger and stronger, and are always composed differently.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43519985/b79ec165ad09b057a89fb9eaaf64d35bccc6c0ef.jpg
We have worked hard to ensure that the waves are both interesting and sufficiently random, so that you never know what to expect. Some will be very fun to see, and our new unit will also make an appearance! (More information about that unit at a later date ;) )

In co-op, you will each have your nests, which means you won’t be able to interact with the nests of your ally. That being said, you can (and SHOULD!) defend all nests: yours and theirs. Your powers will affect your ally’s units as well, so plan those powers carefully to optimize your run.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43519985/080068c52aa99931bc35dfa770d582482b89767f.jpg
Each run will give you a certain number of points. Try to get the highest score possible to see who is the best at defending the colony! Tip: the longer you resist, the more points you will gain. For the next run, try to survive for a few more seconds!

Can’t wait to learn more about the Summer Update? More information will be coming your way soon enough!

notes.title: 🛠️❄️ The Winter Update 2024 is Here
notes.notes:
Greetings, fellow ants! 🐜

Winter is almost upon us, and the team at Tower Five has been busy with a new update!
Here’s what’s new:

New Features
Skirmish mode - Hone your strategic skills and practice against 1 or 2 AI in offline mode
Master AI player setting - Reacts swiftly and strategically, using pheromone powers. The advanced AI processes situations faster than usual, adapting seamlessly to real-time changes and employing powers for a challenging gameplay experience
Arabic localization
Main Updates
In Ta-yu-kan, the exploration missions “Lost sisters” and “Second hunt” are now optional
Changed the sonar (e.g. in the “Lost sisters” mission)
Added 2 minutes to the allowed time in the mission “Stockpiling”
Removed gunner enemies from some waves in the mission “A city under attack”
Changed the color of the shield indicators for better visibility
Bug Fixes
Fixed several crashes
Fixed bugs corrupting saves
Fixed screen tearing issue when DLSS is activated
Optimized the main menu for ultra-widescreen (32:9)
Reduced the blurry outline effect around moving objects (e.g. around 103,683rd) created by TSR in Performance mode at resolutions lower than 1440p
Fixed third shield charge that was not applying properly
Fixed several localization issues

Thank you for your feedback, we’ll keep you updated for future updates!

For the glory of the colony 🌿🐜

notes.title: 🛠️ Update 1.02.19779 Now Available
notes.notes:
Greetings, fellow ants! 🐜

We’ve deployed a new patch with several enhancements, fixes, and balance adjustments for Empire of the Ants. Here’s what’s new:

Additions and Improvements
Added support for monitors with different aspect ratios (e.g. Steam Deck, widescreen
monitors)
Added a field-of-view slider in the Video Options
Added a monitor selection option in the Video Options
Improved the “Vertical sync” option to work with high refresh rate monitors
Increased maximum frame rate to 144 FPS
Fixes
Fix for rare hang when commanding Hornets
Fix for ‘Space bar’ indicator to restart a mission not working
Fixed a fatal error when starting the game on a PC that has DLSS Frame Generation
(i.e. Nvidia RTX 40 series card)
Fix for missing sounds in missions
Multiplayer balancing
Defense upgrade changes
The “protective Barrier” upgrade provides 15% HP in shield instead of 20%
Slightly increased Nest gunners Tier 1 damage to Hornets
Slightly decreased Nest gunners Tier 3 damage to Hornets
Super predator changes
Nerfed the Dor Beetles (blue beetles):
They will take more damage than they used to (compared to Rose Chafers they
now take 70% of the damage instead of 50% - they have the same amount of
HP)
Reduced by 20% the damage they deal across the board
Increased damage inflicted by Hornets to ant/termite legions
Decreased damage inflicted by Hornets to creeps (Firebugs/Ladybygs/Spiders/etc.)
Support changes
Increased aphid healing range from 300 (which was a bug) to 1500
Decreased max shield value provided by snail from 40% to 30%,
Decreased the time it takes to fill up Snail's shield from 20sec to 15sec
Power changes
Powers start with their cooldown at 0% charged instead of 100% charged
It however keeps the previous charges as they were
So if you had a T1 Rage charge at 53% cooldown, and built the T2 Rage you
will have one charge at 53% and the second charge at 0%
Increased all but 2 power prices from 20/30/40 to 20/40/60.
Burrow and Gnat Spies remain unchanged.
Decreased build time for all powers from 20sec to 5sec
The “Shielding spores” power has been changed as follows:
Each charge now gives 15% HP instead of 30% HP in shield
Shield cap used to be 90% for all tiers, now it depends on the Shield power
tier:
Tier 1 caps at 15% HP
Tier 2 caps at 30% HP
Tier 3 caps at 45% HP
To be noted, they still stack with Snail and the protective Barrier up to 90%
HP, maximum.

Thank you for your feedback, we’ll keep you updated for future updates!
